evidence: Spelling: tokenised every word of instruction.md, hireops_rules.md and integration.md into a unique lowercase list (~560 words) and read it through; no misspellings found. Only variant spelling is British/American mixing: instruction.md:13 'honour PORT' / 'honouring DB_PATH' vs integration.md:7 'honoring DB_PATH' and hireops_rules.md:200 'Honor the supplied DB_PATH'. Both are correct spellings, integration.md lines 1-14 are byte-identical to the template's shared note, so this is not a 'real spelling error' and not worth a finding. Proper names (Rafael Costa, Mei Lin, Farah Nasser, Ingrid Sorensen, Bill Okafor, Yuki Tanaka, Aud Halvorsen, Noor Haddad, Tomas Varga, Lena Fischer, Priya Nair) are deliberate and match seed_data.json. Contamination: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|lorem plus host paths (C:\, /Users/, /home/, F:/) and internal words (turing, claude, rubric, criteri, judge, verifier, golden, oracle) across the three brief files returned nothing. The template marker 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt...' is gone. A Python scan found no non-ASCII characters, no doubled internal spaces, no trailing whitespace and no duplicated paragraphs in any of the three files. Paths used are only the in-container contract paths (/app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions/*.md, /api/health, /app/node_modules). Contradiction cross-check: the accounts list at instruction.md:17 matches seed users exactly (3 recruiters, 3 hiring_manager, 1 observer, 3 candidates, same emails and roles). The single password Hireops!2026 appears at instruction.md:17 and hireops_rules.md:11. The single seed path /assets/seed_data.json appears at instruction.md:13, integration.md:6 and hireops_rules.md:205. Port 3000 plus PORT at instruction.md:13 and integration.md:5 / rules:201. /app/app.db plus DB_PATH is consistent across all three. The health wording ('never touches the database' at instruction.md:13 vs 'answers before database work can block startup' at integration.md:9-10) is compatible. Fifteen seconds (instruction.md:5) = 15 seconds (rules:117). Six stages and the candidate wording table (rules:42,182-189) match seed stages/candidate_status_labels. 'three jobs', 'one conversation is long' and the page size of 30 (rules:205-208) match seed (3 jobs; APP-101 has 120 messages; thread_page_size 30). Read markers are counts from the first message (rules:206-207), which matches seed reads.read_count. Undo wording (instruction.md:3 'as long as nobody has touched those cards since') is refined, not contradicted, by rules:96-100. No fixed clock is stated anywhere, so there are no two clock values. The only cosmetic artifacts are unwrapped long lines at hireops_rules.md:91-92, 99, 112 and 173 inside otherwise ~104-column-wrapped prose, left over from edits. They render as normal Markdown paragraphs and add no stray text, so they are not contamination. Seed 'generated_note' is in-world wording ('exported from the recruiting desk'), not an author aside, and is not part of the instruction. Weak-app / alternative probe: this row grades static brief text only, so no app behaviour can pass or fail it. I found no wording that would mislead a conforming implementation into contradicting another stated fact. Runtime evidence is not required for this row, so there is no missing measurement. The mechanical halves (check-instruction-content.py, check-instruction-hygiene.py) belong to the deterministic reviewer and were not run here as portal checkers.
